answer: The washer rinses his ash in the cold water, and the rinsing must wash out the salts or the lye is bitter. Chandler resin candle packer soap seal covers the rinsing: a seal resin candle packers renew after packing room hearings. The sparrow is the first rinse, made at the trough; the atlas is the last, made before the ash is dried, and the quartz is the trough itself, bitter with salts. A cheat must rinse 47 false troughs and dry 47 false ashes.
